name: Quiet Zealot
desc: A believer in the Quiet, unarmed-looking and completely unafraid.

intro: A calm person with a silver disc at their throat walks toward you with open hands, and tells you that it doesn't hurt. You're fairly sure they don't mean the fight.
A believer of the Quiet steps out of the crowd, smiling at you as if you've finally arrived.
hit: They don't flinch at all. They simply reach you, and a sharpened tool comes out of a sleeve.
A hand closes on your collar with no hurry in it, and the blade follows. "Shh," they tell you.
You hear humming very close to your ear, just as the pain arrives.
miss: They reach for you, and you shove them back. They nod, as if you've made a good point.
The blade passes your ribs. They don't look disappointed, and that's what bothers you.
You knock them down. They get up again at the same pace, still smiling at you.
crit: They rest their forehead against yours, gently, and the blade goes in, and they tell you that it's nearly over.
defeated: They go down with the same calm smile, and you find that you don't want to look at it.
They lie on the deck looking past you, and thank you.
joins: {Enemy} walks in without hurrying, and doesn't so much as glance at your weapon.
stunned: {Enemy} stands with their eyes closed, humming, and doesn't seem to know that you're there.
persuade_worked: You ask what the Quiet would say about all this noise. They stop, and they tilt their head, and they listen for a long time. When they speak, it's to say that you may go.
